chapter: Chicago and New York with Louis Armstrong, 1925-30
title: Kelly's Stables with Baby Dodds, before the union card
summary: Zutty explains Kelly's was a small gig that the New Orleans boys gave him before his union wait ended, with Charlie Alexander and Dominique in the group.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Yes, I see. Well what did you do then after the Nest was that the, where did you go from there?
Well after the Nest I went to, where did I go after the Nest?
Oh that was just a little gig
The boys were looking out for Zutty you know from New Orleans if they could do something or throw something his way. That was before you were supposed to play. The three months wasn't up.
Well who were you playing with at Kelly's Stable then?
It was the Baby Dots (Dods' jck.
It was Baby Dods, he was the one that put me in this place.
Yes, I've got you there, yes.
That was Charlie Alexander and old Dominique.
